verdict.rationale: Second-factor authentication is a fair question for a self-hosted Git service, so the axis applies. The pack never mentions WebAuthn, passkeys, U2F, hardware security keys or two-factor authentication. Its security evidence covers only permissions, access control lists, audit logs, SAML SSO, OAuth2 and OIDC, which are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use a hardware security key or passkey as a second factor
